scope: Timing-only cache levels and capacity; OS cache geometry was inspected for platform compatibility and is not used as experimental evidence.

capacity_estimates.evidence: 32 KiB: 3.46875 ticks/load in all three primary-layout runs across rounds; 36 KiB: 5.0625, P05-P95 4.875-5.34375. 2-16 KiB: 3.1875.
512 KiB: 9.1875 ticks/load in all three primary-layout runs; 576 KiB: 15.75, P05-P95 14.71875-17.25. 1 MiB repeats: 23.25-23.34375.

capacity_estimates.interpretation: Effective onset near the 16 MiB low-latency endpoint; no uniquely established nominal physical capacity or aggregate socket/system capacity.

caveats: Intervals are empirical sampling brackets, not confidence intervals.
Layout and base-page controls differ substantially; the experiment does not uniquely isolate the causes.
Involuntary switches total 430 in round 1 and 787 in round 2; no samples removed.
The largest within-point temporal-decile median ratio is 1.058824 at the 640 KiB round-2 point.
AMD LFENCE serialization relies on standard Linux AMD initialization; the privileged DE_CFG register was not read directly.
third_round: Not run: the requested two rounds are complete. The L1/L2 estimates and bounded LLC transition can be reported at the present sampling resolution.
